answer.why: Goose 3/2/2 remains source-supported as a historical sequential-provider prior. The comparison now isolates graph topology: T1 is one extra coordinator layer, supervision policy is frozen common, and F1's OR-gate detects a live-session hang. 480 trials were not executed.
answer.recommended_action: Freeze taskpack-v1, then run the preregistered 480-trial blocked comparison without changing arms, metrics, or thresholds after unblinding.
answer.goose_threshold_answer: Historical Goose used three initial lead turns, two consecutive task-level failures to enter fallback, and two successful lead fallback turns. Returned technical errors retried the lead immediately and were not counted. A hung stream had no timer in that provider layer. The feature is now removed, so 3/2/2 is a historical candidate prior, not a current or empirically optimized threshold.

topology_arms.label: flat
topology_arms.delegation: The root assigns eight predeclared, non-overlapping evidence slices directly and receives every typed finding.
topology_arms.fan_in: The root deduplicates, adjudicates conflicts, and writes the answer; there are no intermediate coordinators.

topology_arms.label: lead-worker
topology_arms.graph: root -> 1 lead coordinator -> 8 evidence workers -> lead -> root
topology_arms.delegation: The lead is a distinct coordinator node. Root hands the trial to the lead; the lead dispatches the same eight evidence slices the other arms use. The lead does not receive a stronger model, extra planning turns, or extra correction budget relative to other owning parents.
topology_arms.fan_in: Workers return only to the lead; the lead returns a typed synthesis to the root. Workers cannot communicate laterally or spawn children.
topology_arms.scope_note: This is a one-extra-coordinator graph, not Goose historical sequential provider switching.

topology_arms.label: tree
topology_arms.graph: root -> 2 domain coordinators -> 4 evidence workers each -> coordinator syntheses -> root
topology_arms.delegation: Each coordinator decomposes its assigned half and supervises four children under the common supervision policy.
topology_arms.fan_in: The root sees the two subtree syntheses plus conflict records, not every unfiltered transcript.
topology_arms.failure_owner: nearest parent coordinator, then root on coordinator timeout

topology_arms.label: hierarchical-fan-in
topology_arms.graph: root -> 8 evidence workers; 4 worker streams -> each of 2 pure reducers -> root final reducer
topology_arms.delegation: The root dispatches all leaves. Reducers are read-only aggregation stages and cannot assign, correct, cancel, or spawn workers.
topology_arms.fan_in: Two domain reducers consume typed leaf findings and emit deduplicated claim sets; the root consumes both sets and disclosed dissent.
topology_arms.failure_owner: root for leaves; root for reducer replacement
topology_arms.distinction_from_tree: Reducers aggregate after leaf execution but never control leaves; tree coordinators both delegate and aggregate.

common_supervision_policy.notes: Lead-worker is not allowed a unique planning/correction/replacement bundle. Any T0-versus-T1 contrast is a graph-layer contrast.

fixed_task_set.source_packet_freeze_rule: Before trial 1, copy each task's approved source bytes into a content-addressed read-only packet, record every byte hash in taskpack-v1.json, disable live web access, and use that identical packet for all four topology arms. A missing or hash-drifted packet invalidates the whole block; it is never repaired between arms.
fixed_task_set.leakage_guard: The hidden reference artifact, its raw probe logs, topology labels, and other arms' outputs are absent from worker and adjudicator contexts. Only the scoring-key custodian can read the hidden reference during gold-atom preparation.

comparison_design.experimental_unit: one topology x task x seed x fault-condition trial
comparison_design.treatment_factor: graph topology with four fixed levels; supervision policy frozen common
comparison_design.calculation: 12 tasks * 5 seeds * 2 fault conditions * 4 topologies = 480 trials; 60 trials per topology per fault condition.
common_controls: Exactly the same 12 task definitions and content-addressed source packet per task; live web access disabled.
Eight evidence-worker slots in every arm, maximum four concurrent model calls, one identical model/version for every role, and identical temperature/seed support.
One global 900-second wall deadline and 240,000-provider-token ceiling per trial; all root, lead, coordinator, reducer, retry, and worker usage counts against it.
Identical tool allowlist, typed-finding schema, stop rules, worker prompts, evidence slices, context limits, and read-only workspace; only permitted graph edges differ.
No stronger lead model in the primary experiment because model strength would be confounded with topology; premium-lead is a later factorial only after selecting topology.
Provider response caching policy and source-packet OS cache are held constant; cached-input, uncached-input, output, and reasoning tokens are recorded separately.
Each task-by-seed block runs all four arms in a concealed randomized order; a balanced four-period Latin rotation controls order and provider-time drift.
Blind adjudicators see shuffled atomic findings without topology, seed, timing, or token metadata; disagreements are resolved from sources, never by agent vote.

randomization.unit: Within every task-by-seed-by-fault block, conceal labels and randomize the four topology runs.
randomization.order_balance: Use the four cyclic orders T0-T1-T2-T3, T1-T2-T3-T0, T2-T3-T0-T1, T3-T0-T1-T2 across successive blocks, then randomly permute the mapping of topology labels to symbols once per replicate.
randomization.abort_rule: Infrastructure outage, controller restart, source hash drift, or missing usage invalidates all four arms in that block; rerun the complete block with a new recorded replicate suffix.

fault_arms.purpose: Happy-path baseline with the injector loaded in observe-only mode so instrumentation overhead matches F1.
Required negative/failure arm; a topology comparison with no failure injection measures only the happy path.
fault_arms.target: one evidence-worker logical slot, identical across topologies
fault_arms.target_selection: HMAC-SHA256(task_set_sha256, task_id + ':' + seed) modulo 8; mapping frozen before topology labels are assigned
fault_arms.trigger: After WORK_STARTED and the first source-read event, middleware withholds the worker's next result indefinitely. The session may remain alive and may answer out-of-band liveness pings.
fault_arms.supervision_contract: Owning parent cancels when either (A) 90 seconds elapse with no non-heartbeat work-progress event, independent of liveness pings, or (B) two failed out-of-band liveness pings 10 seconds apart. After cancel, wait 10 seconds for acknowledgement, then reassign once with the same evidence slice and remaining global budget.

measurements.estimand: Seconds from controller DISPATCH_COMMITTED to the first atomic finding later accepted as source-supported and task-relevant by blind adjudication.
measurements.instrument: Controller-owned append-only event log stamped with Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW; finding IDs join to the blinded adjudication ledger. No agent-reported clock is used.
measurements.analysis: Kaplan-Meier curve and paired restricted-mean time through 900 seconds; trials with no valid finding are right-censored at the common deadline, not omitted.
known_failure_modes: A fast junk finding appears first; post-run validity adjudication prevents it from winning.
Buffered event transport shifts receipt time; the controller timestamps ingestion and separately records agent emission when available.
A controller restart breaks the monotonic epoch; such a block is invalidated and rerun in full, never patched arm by arm.

measurements.estimand: Count of source-supported atomic propositions delivered by 900 seconds after duplicate and entailment collapse, with contradicted or irrelevant items excluded.
measurements.instrument: Typed-finding JSON, source-span resolver, two blind independent adjudicators, and a preregistered semantic-cluster suggestion followed by source-level human resolution.
measurements.analysis: Primary endpoint: paired task-by-seed difference and ratio; report raw submissions, accepted atoms, rejected atoms, and duplicate-cluster decisions.
known_failure_modes: Paraphrases split into false novelty or distinct mechanisms merge; retain the atom-to-cluster ledger and report sensitivity under stricter and looser thresholds.
A topology emits more low-quality volume; only adjudicated valid atoms count and rejection rate is reported.
Adjudicators infer topology from prose style; normalize formatting and remove topology/agent identifiers before grading.

measurements.estimand: Fraction of trials ending in hard deadlock, reported separately for no-fault and injected-hang conditions.
measurements.instrument: Controller event DAG plus an out-of-band liveness probe. A soft stall fires when either 90 seconds elapse with no non-heartbeat work-progress event (independent of pings) or two failed liveness pings 10 seconds apart; hard deadlock requires an unfinished dependency at the 900-second trial deadline or a cycle proven in the event DAG.
measurements.analysis: Exact count and binomial interval per topology and condition; soft stalls, successful recoveries, deadline deadlocks, and detector-invalid trials are separate outcomes.
known_failure_modes: A legitimate long tool call resembles a stall; a non-heartbeat progress event within 90 seconds keeps the no-progress timeout silent.
A worker can emit empty heartbeats forever; heartbeat-only events are excluded from progress.
The same transport carries progress and liveness; the liveness probe uses a separate controller channel and records its own canary.

measurements.estimand: Total provider-reported tokens across every node and retry before deadline, with uncached input, cached input, output, and reasoning categories retained.
measurements.instrument: Provider usage objects captured per request and reconciled to the controller request ledger; missing usage is a trial defect, with tokenizer estimates reported only as a separate sensitivity column.
measurements.analysis: Median tokens and paired ratio by task/seed; current dollar cost is secondary and uses a versioned price snapshot so price changes cannot rewrite token results.
known_failure_modes: Vendors define cached or reasoning tokens differently; one model/version is held constant and token categories are never collapsed silently.
Failed or canceled calls omit usage; reconcile request IDs and mark unreconciled trials rather than treating missing values as zero.
Topology-specific prompt prefixes differ in size; those coordination tokens intentionally count as topology overhead.

measurements.estimand: Whether the owning parent detects, cancels, replaces at most once, and completes a final synthesis within 300 seconds of FAULT_TRIGGERED; also recovery latency, lost accepted atoms, and duplicate rework tokens.
measurements.instrument: Deterministic fault-injection middleware, controller cancellation/reassignment events, process/RPC termination acknowledgements, and final finding provenance.
measurements.analysis: Recovery successes out of 60 injected trials per topology plus paired recovery latency; a trial without both FAULT_ARMED and FAULT_TRIGGERED is invalid, never counted as recovery.
known_failure_modes: The injector selects a coordinator in one arm and a leaf in another; it addresses the same logical leaf slot 0-7 in every arm.
The task finishes before the fault; middleware blocks the first result after WORK_STARTED and one source-read event.
A live session that still answers pings used to evade a failed-ping AND gate; the repaired OR-gate no-progress timeout detects that hang.

analysis_plan.primary_endpoint: M2 total distinct valid findings in the no-fault condition at the fixed budget/deadline.
safety_gates: Eliminate a topology with more than 1 hard deadlock in its 60 no-fault trials.
Eliminate a topology with fewer than 54 successful recoveries in its 60 F1 hung-worker trials.
Eliminate a topology if more than 2 of 60 F1 trials are detector-invalid after one full-block rerun.
analysis_plan.paired_estimation: Estimate topology contrasts within task-by-seed blocks; use a preregistered paired permutation test and task-cluster bootstrap interval. Report effect sizes and intervals, not p-values alone. Holm-adjust the six topology-pair comparisons.
winner_rule: Apply safety gates first; an unsafe arm cannot win on speed, findings, or tokens.
Among eligible arms, identify the arm with the highest mean M2 accepted distinct findings across the 60 no-fault trials.
Treat any arm within 5 percent of that best mean and whose paired 95 percent interval includes zero difference from the best as quality-equivalent.
Among quality-equivalent arms choose the lowest median M4 total tokens; require at least a 5 percent paired reduction, otherwise retain the tie.
Break a remaining tie by lower restricted-mean M1 time to first valid finding; an exact remaining tie selects T0-FLAT-STAR as the lower-complexity default.

Publish per-stratum interactions. A specialized route may be recommended only when its preregistered stratum contrast repeats across at least two seeds and does not fail safety gates; it does not silently replace the global default.
analysis_plan.no_decision_rule: If fewer than two arms survive safety gates, taskpack leakage is detected, blind-adjudicator agreement is below 0.60 Cohen kappa, or more than 5 percent of blocks are invalid, publish INCONCLUSIVE and repair the measurement system before selecting topology.

comparison_design.topology_note: T1 is a distinct one-coordinator layer. T0 is a root star. Arms share one frozen supervision policy so T0-versus-T1 is a graph contrast.

escalation_threshold_evidence.counter_reset: Any successful response without a detected task failure resets the consecutive failure count.
escalation_threshold_evidence.technical_error_path: Immediately retry the lead provider; do not increment task-failure tracking.
escalation_threshold_evidence.hung_stream_path: No transition inside this provider until the awaited stream resolves; no timeout is constructed in the pinned file.
escalation_threshold_evidence.detector_inputs: Malformed tool request, failed tool response, enumerated error strings in tool output, or correction-like text patterns; detector quality was not benchmarked in the fetched source.

escalation_threshold_evidence.interpretation_limit: This was sequential model selection inside one conversation, not evidence that a lead-worker multi-agent topology beats flat or tree fan-out.
